title: Lemon Olive Oil Honey Cake
description: A 6-ingredient gluten-free cake built around a whole boiled lemon blended with olive oil, honey, and eggs, then folded with oat flour. Moist and naturally sweet, finished with an optional whipped honey glaze and lemon zest.

ingredients.note: mentioned in transcript as a finishing garnish; no amount given

steps.title: Boil the lemon
steps.text: Place {i01} in a pot of boiling water and let it simmer for 25 minutes until fully softened.

steps.title: Blend wet ingredients
steps.text: Transfer the boiled {i01} to a blender along with {i02}, {i03}, and {i04}. Blend for 1–2 minutes until completely smooth — there should be no chunks of lemon remaining.

steps.title: Fold in dry ingredients
steps.text: Pour the blended mixture into a large bowl. Add {i05}, {i06}, and {i07}. Fold gently with a spatula — do not whisk. Folding is important with oat flour to avoid a gummy texture.

steps.title: Rest the batter
steps.text: Cover the bowl with a towel and let the batter rest at room temperature for 10 minutes. This step prevents a gummy texture in the finished cake.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour the batter into a deep dish cake pan and bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool the cake
steps.text: Remove the cake from the oven and allow it to cool fully before slicing or glazing.

steps.title: Make whipped honey glaze (optional)
steps.text: Whip {i08} until it becomes lighter and glossy. Spread or drizzle over the cooled cake.

steps.title: Slice and garnish
steps.text: Slice the cake into 7–8 pieces. Finish with a little {i09} on top if desired.

rawText:
CAPTION (as written by the author -- trust these amounts):
6 ingredient lemon olive oil honey cake

1 large lemon
1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
1/2 cup honey
3 eggs
1.5 cups oat flour
2 tsp baking powder
pinch of salt
1/4 cup honey for whipped honey glaze (optional)

- Boil lemon for 25 minutes
- Place in blender with oil, honey, eggs
- In a bowl, mix together all ingredients
- Cover bowl with a towel and let sit at room temp for 10 minutes… this ensures no gummy texture
- Preheat oven to 350F
- Bake for about 40 minutes

#healthy #food #cakes #glutenfree

SPOKEN TRANSCRIPT (what they say in the video -- the method is usually here, and often includes steps the caption omits):
Apparently, if you place a lemon into boiling water and let it simmer for about 25 minutes, and then place it in the blender with extra virgin olive oil, a nice chunk of honey, and not one, not two, but three eggs, and let it blend for a good minute or two until everything's nice and smoothie, because you're going to get chunks of lemon in there. Wow! Well, that's nice. Then pop it into a bowl, and here you're going to put your dry ingredients that's just oat flour and a little bit of baking powder, and don't whisk it. You want to fold it with a spatula because it's oat, and you want to let it rest for 10 minutes before putting into your deep dish at 350 in the oven for about 40 minutes. And this is extra, but if you want, you could do some whipped honey. It's like a nice glaze to put on top. Once your cake cools and is ready to cut, slice it into how many pieces you want. I did about seven or eight with that glaze on top, a little bit more lemon zest. Wow! That's incredible. Obviously very moist because of the olive oil, and sweet because of the honey. That's great!
